title: GitHub Control-Plane Integration
summary: Create a deterministic, read-only-first GitHub control plane that correlates the fawxzzy repository ecosystem with local Git, _stack events, Atlas contracts and receipts, DiscordOS projections, Vercel delivery, and Supabase operational evidence without weakening mutation authority.

metadata.objective: Create a deterministic, read-only-first GitHub control plane that correlates the fawxzzy repository ecosystem with local Git, _stack events, Atlas contracts and receipts, DiscordOS projections, Vercel delivery, and Supabase operational evidence without weakening mutation authority.

authority.projection_authority: DiscordOS single writer after accepted event admission
authority.security_authority: explicit operator authorization for containment, rotation, verification, alert handling, and any history decision
authority.unknown_or_access_denied_evidence_policy: Record the endpoint and state; never invent facts, zeroes, percentages, protection, security, or adoption.

phases.title: Automated inventory
phases.objective: Collect deterministic repository/component metadata with account, timestamp, freshness, endpoint state, and stable ordering.
phases.acceptance_gate: Two repeat collections produce schema-valid, semantically equivalent output except for declared volatile facts.

phases.title: Parity monitoring
phases.objective: Correlate local HEAD/tracking refs, live cloud defaults, branches, and worktrees without implicit fetch or mutation.
phases.acceptance_gate: Every governed checkout has separate local-tracking and live-cloud parity facts or explicit not-applicable/unknown.

phases.title: Actions monitoring
phases.objective: Project workflows, bounded run samples, failure families, owners, recurrence, and recovery receipts.
phases.acceptance_gate: Playbook and Fitness recovery queues close only on owner-side fix proof and fresh successful runs.

phases.title: PR and issue hygiene
phases.objective: Maintain evidence-backed disposition, stacked dependency, checks, mergeability, ownership, and terminal reconciliation.
phases.acceptance_gate: Every open item has one allowed disposition; terminal changes reconcile without automatic mutation.

phases.title: Release and security signals
phases.objective: Project release, protection/ruleset, Dependabot, and secret-scanning facts with endpoint-specific access states.
phases.acceptance_gate: Disabled, empty, denied, conflicting, and unknown remain distinct; every gap has an owner decision.

phases.title: Governed cleanup
phases.objective: Recalculate branch/worktree candidates and execute only admitted retention classes with idempotent receipts.
phases.acceptance_gate: No cleanup occurs without fresh exclusions, explicit authority, pre/post evidence, and correlated receipts.

phases.title: DiscordOS projections
phases.objective: Emit accepted GitHub event families through _stack and project authorized board/Update state through DiscordOS.
phases.acceptance_gate: Idempotent events, event-specific formatting, single-writer enforcement, and readback are proven end to end.

acceptance_criteria: The registry covers all ten fawxzzy repositories plus local-only Stream and remote-only Cortex with deterministic order and explicit unknown/access_denied states.
Local tracking parity and live cloud-default comparison remain separate and freshness-stamped.
Actions, open work, release, protection, rulesets, Dependabot, and secret scanning are projected without empty-as-healthy inference.
Remote branch and local worktree candidates remain separate, exclusion-aware, retention-aware, and non-mutating until admitted.
_stack emits correlated facts, Atlas preserves contracts/receipts/markers, and DiscordOS returns idempotent readback for authorized projections.
Vercel and Supabase evidence correlates to GitHub SHAs/runs without bypassing production, security, or live-data authority.
Opening and closing audits prove their own gates; historical closeouts do not substitute for current health.
dependencies: Accepted and published opening audit and registry
_stack GitHub event and correlated receipt family
DiscordOS single-writer adapter and readback contract
Owner-side Playbook demo contract synchronization recovery
Operator-authorized Fitness security containment, rotation, and verification
risks: Volatile branch, PR, workflow, and worktree state can invalidate cleanup evidence quickly.
Dependabot access_denied/disabled evidence may be mistaken for zero alerts.
Fitness's open Critical alert may be omitted or product work resumed prematurely.
Zero workflows or releases may be mislabeled as health.
Stale inventory or tracking refs may be treated as live parity.
Cross-plane correlation may accidentally expand mutation authority.
Owner-lane worktrees may be removed before retention is proven.

measurement_units.unit: 10/10 cloud repositories plus declared local-only and remote-only components freshness-stamped
every governed checkout has local-tracking and live-cloud parity or explicit not-applicable evidence
workflow inventory and bounded health samples with recovery ownership
every open PR and issue has an evidence-backed allowed disposition
release, protection, ruleset, Dependabot, and secret-scanning states visible or endpoint-specifically unknown
remote branches and local worktrees classified with exclusions, retention, authority, and receipts
_stack emits idempotent GitHub facts correlated to Atlas receipts
authorized GitHub events project through DiscordOS with readback

github_control_plane_integration.ratchet_rule: Percentage remains null until an authorized marker audit accepts a deterministic denominator and completed units.

opening_gate.gate: Move only after exhaustive opening-pass proof is accepted by the opening marker audit.

closing_gate.gate: Move only after exhaustive closing-pass proof and closing marker audit acceptance.

atlas_full_system_re_evaluation.discovered_work_rule: Every discovered work item becomes a separate named lane and never inflates the re-evaluation marker.

global.requirement: Corrected GitHub opening evidence must be accepted and published.
The accepted opening marker audit must approve any marker movement or owner-lane resume.

security_blockers.requirement: Explicit operator-authorized containment, rotation, and verification are required after global gates. Rotation is mandatory if the key is or was live. Git history remediation is a separate explicit decision and is not automatic.

named_follow_up_lanes.reason: ATLAS/_stack inventory and _stack lock head drift
